sentences.text: Eromangasaurus is an extinct genus of elasmosaurid plesiosaur found in northern Queensland, Australia.
This large marine reptile reached seven meters in length and weighed between one and two metric tons.
Benjamin P. Kear first named the genus Eromangasaurus in 2005, with Eromangasaurus australis as the type species.
Fossil evidence indicates this animal primarily fed on clams and snails.
Scientists classify Eromangasaurus within the family Elasmosauridae.
The time range for Eromangasaurus is the Albian stage, spanning from 106.3 to 100.5 million years ago.
